overhaulLuaReload.onDown: if overhaul_shell_gameMode and overhaul_shell_gameMode.isActive() then if overhaul_career_saveSystem and overhaul_career_saveSystem.requestLuaReload then overhaul_career_saveSystem.requestLuaReload() else Lua:requestReload(); ui_message('engine.lua.reloaded', 2, 'lua', 'refresh') end end
overhaulLuaReload.title: Reload Lua (Career Overhaul)
overhaulLuaReload.desc: In Career Overhaul, saves the career before reloading Lua. Replaces the game's Lua reload while Career Overhaul runs.
